streams.name: synthetic-week
streams.title: A synthetic week
streams.description: One week of hourly flows, pressures, hourly exit-point nominations and bookings generated from the network model, with an unplanned outage at Kollsnes, reduced capacity on Langeled, recurring H2S and CO2 excursions at four fields and a pigging programme on every trunk, export line and interconnector. Synthetic: use it to see how live operations look, not as a record of real flows.
streams.source: Generated by nora.stream.synthesize from data/nodes.csv and data/pipelines.csv

streams.name: denmark-gas-energinet
streams.title: Danish gas flows, Aug to Oct 2026
streams.description: Measured daily flows through the Danish gas system from Energinet: Tyra's output into Nybro, gas arriving from the North Sea (mostly Norwegian gas through Baltic Pipe), the onward flow to Poland and Danish consumption. Real data for four pipelines; the rest of the chart has no readings.
streams.license: Open data from Energinet's Energi Data Service; credit Energinet as the source

streams.name: norway-exports
streams.title: Norwegian gas landings (FR & BE), Oct 2026
streams.description: Hourly physical flows where Norwegian gas lands on the continent: Dunkerque (Franpipe) and Zeebrugge ZPT (Zeepipe I). Real data from the ENTSOG Transparency Platform. The UK (St Fergus, Easington) and German (Dornum, Emden) points publish nothing here, so those pipelines have no readings in this dataset.
streams.license: ENTSOG Transparency Platform terms of use; credit ENTSOG as the source

streams.name: sodir-field-production
streams.title: Norwegian field production, Sep 2024 to Aug 2026
streams.description: Monthly net gas produced by Norwegian offshore fields, from the Norwegian Offshore Directorate (SODIR) factpages. Real monthly averages for the fields NORA models; Sleipner Vest and Øst are summed into the Sleipner node. The rest of the chart has no readings.
streams.license: Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD), https://data.norge.no/nlod/en; credit SODIR as the source
